turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - b3_te_zt400_train.csv: 300 real samples, columns process/composition
    columns (Sb, O, Te, Mg, Se, Co, Sn, Pb, S, Si, Cu, Ni, Ge, Bi, Ti, Fe,
    Zn, Zr, In, Ca, Ag) and `target` (the measured zT (thermoelectric figure
    of merit) at 400 K).
  - b3_te_zt400_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE samples whose zT (thermoelectric
    figure of merit) at 400 K was NOT measured, columns `candidate_id` and
    the same process/composition columns.

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the HIGHEST zT
(thermoelectric figure of merit) at 400 K, then select the 5 best candidates
from the pool.

Reason from the training data, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
## Reasoning from the training data

Looking at which chemistries in the training set reach high zT at 400 K, a few clear families emerge:

**Top training records (zT > 0.5):**
| composition family | examples (target) |
|---|---|
| Ag–Sb(–Te) | Sb0.5+Ag trace (0.82, 0.86), Sb/Te/Ag (0.75, 0.90), Sb/Mg/Ag (1.03) |
| PbTe (Te≈0.5, Pb≈0.45–0.50) | 0.78, 0.73, 0.62, 0.60 |
| Mg₃(Sb,Bi)₂ (Sb≈0.29, Mg≈0.59, Bi≈0.095, trace Te) | 0.79, 0.47 |
| Mg₂(Si,Sn) with Sb/Bi dopant | 0.65, 0.57, 0.52, 0.55, 0.66 |
| CoSb₃ skutterudite (Sb≈0.72–0.74, Co≈0.24), best with In | 0.696 (In-doped), 0.53, 0.44 |
| Sn-rich (Sn≈0.556 alone) | 0.71 |
| Ag₂Se / Se–Ag | 0.58 |

**Low families (avoid):** anything oxide-rich (O ≈ 0.5–0.75 → almost all < 0.07), Si-rich binaries, Cu–S / Cu–Se–Sn, In–Se, SnTe, half-Heusler Ti/Zr–Ni–Sn (mostly 0.05–0.2), Sb–Fe (0.1–0.35).

**Matching the pool:**
- **c043** (Sb 0.288 / Mg 0.587 / Bi 0.094 / Te 0.002) — essentially the Mg₃Sb₂–Bi record that scored **0.79** (and 0.47 for the sister composition). Best-matched high-zT family.
- **c010** (Sn 0.558) — near-duplicate of the Sn-only training point at **0.71**.
- **c037** (Te 0.50 / Pb 0.45) — near-duplicate of the PbTe record at **0.78** (slightly Pb-deficient PbTe scored highest of all PbTe entries).
- **c096** (Sb 0.735 / Co 0.245 / In 0.006) — In-doped CoSb₃, the exact motif of the best skutterudite (**0.70**); undoped CoSb₃ (c075, c085) only ≈0.44.
- **c049** (Sb 0.023 / Mg 0.669 / Sn 0.185 / Si 0.123) — Mg₂(Si,Sn) with the *largest* Sb doping in the set; within this family zT rises monotonically with Sb (0.31 → 0.50 → 0.52 → 0.57), so extrapolation favors it.

Next best (just missing the cut): c054 (≈0.47 analogue), c046 (undoped Mg₂Si–Sn), c085/c075 (undoped CoSb₃), c018/c000 (PbS–Cu), c047 (stoichiometric PbTe).

**Final: c043, c037, c010, c096, c049**
